instruction.text: Match the words with their definitions.
Is the word in bold an adjective or an adverb?

atoms.a: His excuse for being late was not credible.
Phaedra did really well on her final exams.
Trenton was terribly upset about failing their driving test.
Thanks to her friends, Juanita never feels lonely.

wrong.text: The word hard is both an adjective and an adverb. The word hardly, on the other hand, means almost never or almost not.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct word.

atoms.b: Darryl ((slow ++slowly)) placed the ((++new newly)) vase on the coffee table.
They ((careful ++carefully)) carried the ((++comfortable comfortably)) chair to the living room.
Her ((++close closely)) friend Nisha plays the piano ((splendid ++splendidly)).
The archeologists were ((complete ++completely)) flabbergasted when they found this ((++ancient anciently)) relic.
